blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.
blocks.zh: 块扩散起草器通过在一次前传中生成多个草稿令牌来加速投机解码. 然而,每次通过只从一个目标产生的锚上产生一个固定长块,从而限制了草案可以延伸多远. 与此同时,目标核查计算出隐藏状态,甚至在第一次拒绝之后的位置,但这些状态通常被丢弃,而不是被再利用。 我们提出ReAnchor,一种无训练方法,利用被废弃的核查状态,在转出的位置上将一个事先训练过的起草者重新锁定,生成平行的区块草稿。 这些区块改进了原区块内的预测并扩展了覆盖范围,超越了它的终点. 在T=0的采样温度下,ReAnchor在Gemma 4-12B上实现了最大平均增益,将接受时间延长了19.4%,分出8个基准的解码速度提高了17.9%. 平均平均在4个目标模型和8个基准上,通过预先训练的DFlash起草器,将接受长度提高了15.2%,解码速度提高了13.4%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Autoregressive large language models generate tokens sequentially, making decoding a major source of inference latency. Speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) reduces this cost by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel with the target model.
Many existing methods use autoregressive drafters ( Li et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024a ) , whose token-by-token generation introduces sequential work into the drafting stage. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash ( Chen et al., 2026 ) remove this sequential dependence by predicting multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass.
blocks.zh:
自动递减的大型语言模型依次生成符号,使解码成为推论延迟的一个主要来源. 光谱解码(Leviathan等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年)通过使用轻量级的起草器提出多个代币,并与目标模型平行验证,降低了这一成本.
许多现有方法使用自递式起草器(Li等人,2026b;Cheng等人,2024;Li等人,2024a),其代号逐字将顺序工作引入起草阶段. DFlash(Chen et al., 2026)等块扩散起草器通过在单个前传中预测多个草稿令牌来消除这种顺序依赖.

blocks.en: This single-pass block generation comes at the cost of flexibility in how draft proposals are used and extended. Unlike autoregressive drafters, which can extend proposals one token at a time and stop when further drafting is unlikely to be worthwhile ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , block diffusion drafters generate a fixed-length block determined by their training configuration. When verification encounters an early rejection, hidden states computed for the remaining draft positions are typically discarded. Conversely, when the entire block is accepted, no further proposals are available beyond its endpoint. Simply increasing the block length at inference time forces the drafter outside its training configuration and degrades acceptance performance ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Thus, block diffusion drafting leaves verifier computations underutilized when proposals are rejected early, while limiting draft coverage when the entire block is accepted.
blocks.zh: 这种单一通道区块生成是以灵活使用和扩大提案草案为代价的。 与自动递减式起草者不同,自动递减式起草者可以一次展出一个标语,当进一步起草不太可能值得时停止(黄 al等人,2024年;张 Zhang等人,2025年),块扩散式起草者产生一个固定长块,由其训练配置决定. 当核查遇到早期拒绝时,通常会放弃为其余的草案位置计算出的隐藏状态。 反之,当整个区块被接受时,除了其终点之外,没有其他提案。 仅仅在推断时间增加区块长度就迫使起草者超出其训练配置,并降低接受性能(Chen等人,2026年)。 因此,块扩散起草使得在早期否决建议书时未充分利用核查器的计算,同时在整个块被接受时限制了草案的涵盖范围。

blocks.en: Our observation is that verifier hidden states computed at discarded draft positions retain useful information for subsequent drafting (Table 1 ). Although these states depend on rejected tokens and cannot be reused as valid target-model states, they can still serve as conditioning signals for the pretrained drafter. This suggests that otherwise discarded verifier computations can be leveraged for additional drafting without further target-model evaluations.
blocks.zh: 我们的意见是,在被丢弃的立场草案中计算出来的核查员隐藏的国家保留了有用的信息,以便随后起草(表1)。 虽然这些状态依赖于被拒绝的令牌,并且不能作为有效的目标模型状态重新使用,但它们仍然可以作为预训起草器的调节信号. 这表明,在不作进一步目标模式评价的情况下,可以利用其他被弃置的核查器计算法来补充起草工作。

blocks.en: Building on this finding, we introduce ReAnchor , a training-free method that reuses verifier hidden states from the discarded post-rejection suffix to reanchor the same pretrained drafter at those later positions. The reanchored blocks are generated in parallel with the baseline draft, each preserving the drafter’s trained block length. To combine these blocks, ReAnchor matches their starting tokens to the baseline and attaches their continuations at the matched positions. By reanchoring at later positions (Figure 1 ), these blocks provide alternative predictions for nearby tokens within the original block, while also extending draft coverage beyond its endpoint. All attached continuations are verified by the target model under their new prefixes, preserving lossless decoding.
blocks.zh: 基于这一发现,我们引入了ReAnchor(无训练)方法,即从废弃的拒绝后后缀中重新使用核查器隐藏状态,以便在这些后期位置重新使用同一预训起草器。 重排区块与基线草案平行产生,每个区块保留起草者训练有素的区块长度。 为了结合这些区块,ReAnchor将它们的起始符号与基线相匹配,并将它们的延续附加在匹配的位置. 通过在后期位置重选(图1),这些区块为原区块内的附近标志物提供了替代预测,同时也将草案覆盖范围扩展到其终点之外. 所有附着的续作都在其新的前缀下通过目标模型进行验证,保留无损解码.

blocks.en: With DFlash drafters, ReAnchor improves average acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% across four target models and eight benchmarks at T = 0 T=0 . The largest average gains are observed on Gemma 4-12B, with improvements of 19.4% in acceptance length and 17.9% in decoding speed. These improvements also extend to three DFlash-based drafter variants, Domino, DSpark, and Draft-OPD, which employ different training and prediction mechanisms. Across 48 comparisons spanning two Qwen3 target models and eight benchmarks, ReAnchor improves average acceptance length by 11.8% and end-to-end decoding speed by 9.8% over their respective baselines. Component-wise ablations further show that both in-block refinement and block extension contribute to these gains.
blocks.zh: 使用DFlash起草器,ReAnchor将平均接受长度提高15.2%,解码速度在T=0 T=0. 在Gemma 4-12B上观察到的最大平均增速,接受长度的改进为19.4%,解码速度的改进为17.9%。 这些改进还扩展到三个基于DFlash的起草器变体,即Domino,DSpark和Draft-OPD,它们采用了不同的培训和预测机制. 在跨越两个Quen3目标模型和八个基准的48个比较中,ReAnchor将平均接受时间比各自的基线提高11.8%,并将端到端的解码速度提高9.8%。 构件分解进一步表明,区块内改进和区块延伸都有助于这些收益。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce ReAnchor, a training-free method that reuses
verifier hidden states as shifted anchors for block diffusion drafting. • ReAnchor improves DFlash by refining predictions within the original block and extending draft coverage beyond it, achieving consistent gains in acceptance length and decoding speed across diverse settings. • We demonstrate that ReAnchor can be directly applied to three DFlash-based variants, Domino, DSpark, and Draft-OPD, without additional training or variant-specific algorithmic modifications.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Revisiting Diffusion Drafting
blocks.zh: 3.1 重新审查传播起草工作

blocks.en:
Block diffusion drafting removes the sequential bottleneck of autoregressive drafters, but the fixed-length parallel block introduces constraints that do not arise in the sequential setting. We now revisit this formulation and examine where its fixed-block design leaves room for improvement. We present two observations that together motivate ReAnchor:
(i) the native block endpoint is frequently the binding constraint
on acceptance length and no proposal exists beyond it, yet naively
extending the block degrades acceptance;
(ii) verifier states computed over rejected draft suffixes retain
substantial predictive information and can condition additional
drafts without retraining.

blocks.en: A direct solution is to increase the proposal length at inference time. We test this by evaluating drafters trained with B = 16 B=16 at B = 24 B=24 and B = 32 B=32 on Qwen3-8B across MATH-500, GSM8K, HumanEval, and MBPP. Despite the additional positions, the average accepted length decreases by 0.3 and 1.1 respectively compared to the native block size. The longer block forces the drafter to predict at offsets beyond its training range from the same anchor, under a masked input configuration it was not trained on. Extending coverage therefore motivates while preserving the native block size. We next examine whether the rejected portion of the preceding verification pass provides the conditioning information needed at these later starting points.

target model. This construction provides alternative predictions within

blocks.en: At T = 0 T=0 , ReAnchor improves both average acceptance length τ \tau and end-to-end speedup in all 32 target–benchmark comparisons, achieving average gains of 15.2% and 13.4% , respectively (Table 2 ). The largest relative gains occur on Gemma 4-12B, with improvements of 19.4% in τ \tau and 17.9% in speedup, despite its shorter baseline accepted prefixes than Qwen3. At T = 1 T=1 , the improvements remain substantial, with τ \tau increasing in 31 of 32 comparisons and speedup in 27, averaging 11.8% and 6.9% , respectively. The smaller gains under stochastic sampling may stem from increased token mismatches between independently sampled draft and target continuations, reducing the benefit of additional proposals relative to their verification cost. Overall, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of reanchoring across different target models and decoding settings.

blocks.en: We analyze where the gains of ReAnchor come from: which draft positions benefit, how much is due to reusing rejected states versus token matching, and how the attachment rule affects performance. All ablations use Qwen3-4B with the DFlash drafter at T = 0 T=0 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ReAnchor, a training-free method that reuses verifier hidden states discarded after rejection to reanchor block diffusion drafting at later positions. By drafting multiple fixed-length blocks in parallel and attaching their continuations through token matching, ReAnchor refines predictions within the original block and extends draft coverage beyond its endpoint, while preserving lossless decoding. It consistently improves acceptance length and decoding speed across target models and benchmarks, and applies directly to DFlash-based drafter variants, including Domino, DSpark, and Draft-OPD. These results show that otherwise discarded verifier computations can be effectively reused to improve speculative decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ReAnchor,一种无训练的方法,它重新使用在拒绝ReAnchor阻断后在后期位置被丢弃的核查器隐藏状态起草. ReAnchor通过平行地起草多个固定长度的块,并通过符号匹配来附加它们的续作,完善了原始块内的预测,并将草稿覆盖范围扩展到其终点以外,同时保留了无损失的解码. 它不断改进目标模型和基准的接受长度和解码速度,并直接适用于基于DFlash的起草器变体,包括Domino,DSpark和Draft-OPD. 这些结果表明,否则被丢弃的核查器计算可以有效地再利用,以改进投机解码.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Like speculative decoding in general, ReAnchor is limited by how well the drafter aligns with the target model.
Shifted blocks are drafted from verifier states conditioned on rejected tokens, so their benefit depends on how much the post-rejection drafts still agree with the target’s continuation. The gains therefore vary across tasks and decoding settings.
At T = 0 T=0 , the average speedup gain is 9.9% on MT-Bench and Alpaca, compared with 14.5% on math and code tasks.
Under stochastic sampling ( T = 1 T=1 ), independently sampled drafts agree less often with the target, and ReAnchor is slower than the baseline on four Llama-3.1-8B tasks and on LiveCodeBench with Qwen3-4B, where the additional verification cost outweighs the extra accepted tokens.
In addition, ReAnchor has no retained states to reuse after a round in which the entire block is accepted, so it cannot extend the draft in consecutive full-acceptance rounds. Finally, all latency measurements use batch size one, where verifying additional trie tokens is nearly free; at larger batch sizes, where verification becomes compute-bound, the extra candidates may reduce the net speedup.

更改后的区块是从核查国起草的,但以被拒绝的代号为条件,因此其好处取决于拒绝后草案仍然同意目标的持续程度。 因此,不同任务和解码设置的收益各不相同。
T=0 T=0时,MT-Bench和Alpaca的平均速度增益为9.9%,而数学和代码任务的平均速度增益为14.5%.
在抽采(T = 1 T = 1)下,独立抽采的抽采稿与标的一致较少,ReAnchor在4项Llama-3.1-8B任务和LiveCode Bench与Qune3-4B任务上比基线慢,后者的额外核查费用超过额外接受的代币.
此外,ReAnchor没有保留状态,在一轮接受整个块后再进行再利用,因此无法在连续的完全接受回合中延长草案. 最后,所有耐用度测量都使用批量尺寸1,其中验证额外三合金符几乎是免费的;在较大的批量尺寸,核查变为计算时,额外候选人可能会减少净速度.

blocks.en:
All implementations for DFlash and its variants are based on the publicly available implementations.
We implement inference in PyTorch with Hugging Face Transformers and run both the target and draft models in bfloat16 using PyTorch SDPA. Due to the nature of ReAnchor that constructs a trie for every decoding round, shifted proposals are not processed in Python but passed in a native C++17 backend, compiled with g++ -O3 as a shared library. The backend aligns each proposal at its longest matching prefix, merges the resulting paths into a token trie, and prepares node, position, and ancestor-attention data; Python transfers these inputs to the GPU for joint verification in one target-model pass. End-to-end latency includes per-round trie construction and preparation of verifier inputs, but excludes model loading, tokenization, and compilation of the C++ backend.

blocks.en: Speculative Decoding. Autoregressive LLMs achieve strong performance but are often noted for their slow decoding speed. While generation must proceed sequentially, verification of multiple tokens can be done in parallel through batched computation ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Speculative decoding exploits this property, using a smaller model (the drafter) to propose tokens and the large model to verify them. Spending more computation on the drafter raises acceptance but slows drafting, so the drafter must align with the verifier under a tight compute budget. SpecInfer ( Miao et al., 2024 ) introduced the tree attention mechanism, which is used broadly by subsequent methods as an almost plug-and-play component. Following Stern et al. (2018) , Medusa ( Cai et al., 2024 ) brings the drafter into the verifier model using multiple decoding heads, since the computation over the prefix has already been done during verification. EAGLE ( Li et al., 2024b ) instead uses a feature-level autoregressive drafter so that the draft carries causality, and its successors add dynamic draft trees ( Li et al., 2024a ) and multi-layer feature fusion ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 标本解码. 自动递减的LLMs能实现强性能,但往往因其解码速度缓慢而被注意. 虽然生成必须依次进行,但可以通过分批计算同时核查多个符号(Leviathan等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年)。 投机性的解码利用了这种属性,使用一个较小的模型(起草者)来提出代币和大模型来验证它们. 在起草器上花费更多的计算会提高接受度但会减慢起草速度,因此起草器必须在严格的计算预算下与核查器保持一致. SpecInfer (Miao et al., 2024)引入了树的注意机制,它被后来的方法广泛用作几乎插件和游戏组件. 继Stern等人(2018年),美杜莎 (Cai et al., 2024)将起草者引入使用多个解码头的核查器模型,因为前缀上的计算已经在核查过程中完成. EAGLE(Li et al.,2024b)转而使用特征级自递式起草器,使草案带有因果关系,其继任者添加动态的草案树(Li et al.,2024a)和多层特征聚变(Li et al.,2026b).

blocks.en:
Diffusion Language Model. Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in any order and in parallel, committing multiple positions per forward pass. Capability has scaled from D3PM ( Austin et al., 2021a ) through continuous-time masked formulations ( Lou et al., 2023 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) to billion-parameter models such as LLaDA ( Nie et al., 2026 ) and Dream ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . Despite this progress, dLLMs have not replaced autoregressive models. Committing more tokens per step degrades quality, since tokens decoded in the same step do not condition on one another ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and the arbitrary decoding order with bidirectional attention prevents KV cache reuse ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
Block diffusion ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) interpolates between the two, using bidirectional attention within a block and causal attention across blocks. This recovers cache reuse at block granularity and yields a block-parallel proposal structure that closely mirrors speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
传播语言模型. 蒙面扩散语言模型在任何顺序上和平行地生成符号,每个前传时会承诺多个位置. 能力已经从D3PM(Austin等人,2021a)通过连续时间遮盖配方扩大。 (Lou等人,2023年;Sahoo等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年)到LLADA(Nie等人,2026年)和Dream(Ye等人,2025年)等十亿参数模型. 尽管取得了这一进展,dLLM并没有取代自动递归模式. 每个步骤上交更多的代币会降低质量,因为在同一步骤上解码的代币不会相互附加条件(Liu等人,2025年),任意的双向注意解码令阻止了KV缓存重用(Wu等人,2026年).
块扩散(Arriola等人,2025年)在二者之间插合,使用块内双向注意和块间因果注意. 这种方法在区块颗粒性时回收缓存再利用,并产生一个区块平行的建议结构,紧密地反映投机解码(Leviathan等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Speculative Decoding with Diffusion Draft Model. Several methods supply drafts through parallel masked prediction, either by sampling candidate paths from a diffusion model and scoring them before committing, or by adapting a small independent model to predict multiple positions at once ( Li et al., 2026a ; An et al., 2026 ) . DFlash ( Chen et al., 2026 ) instead conditions the drafter on the target’s hidden states, following EAGLE ( Li et al., 2024b ) . Subsequent methods weaken the conditional independence inside a block by imposing causal structure among drafted positions ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . D²SD ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) truncates the draft and re-runs the drafter from the accepted prefix, so that later positions are proposed under stronger conditioning. Without retraining the drafter, another line reallocates the verification budget, expanding the per-position marginals into a candidate tree verified in one pass. DDTree ( Ringel and Romano, 2026 ) maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node count, and later work makes the budget adaptive by folding verification cost into the objective ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Oh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 以扩散模型进行分光解码。 几种方法通过平行的蒙面预测提供草稿,方法有的是从扩散模型中取样候选路径,然后在进行试验前加以评分,有的则通过调整一个小型独立模型,以便同时预测多种位置(Li等人,2026a); An et al., 2026 ) (中文(中国大陆) ). DFlash(Chen et al., 2026年)转而将起草者作为目标隐藏状态的条件,遵循EAGLE(Li et al., 2024b.). 随后的方法通过在起草的职位中强加因果结构而削弱一个区块内有条件的独立性(黄等人,2026年;程等人,2026年). D2SD(张等人,2026年a)将草案截断,从被接受的前缀中重新运行起草者,从而在更强的调节下提出后期职位. 在不重新培训起草者的情况下,另一行重新调配核查预算,将每个位置的边距扩大为一张通行证中核实的候选人树。 数字 树(Ringel and Romano, 2026年)在固定节点计数下最大限度地延长预期接受时间,以后的工作通过将核查费用折叠成目标使预算适应性(Zhang等人,2026年b; Oh et al., 2026 (英语).
